shared_elements: horizontal rows or bands of repeated signs
schematic outline figures on a vertical decorated surface
justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces use schematic linear imagery organized in horizontal zones, with some repeated signs and occasional bird/animal-like profile forms. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a sun-disc-with-rays scene, human figures, an altar/shrine, and dense rows of inscription-like signs, while B is dominated by large isolated animals and abstract symbols with no comparable central human-solar ritual scene.
